type Choice = { x: number } | { y: string };
interface Combined extends Choice { label: string; }
interface G<T> extends T { label: string; }
type Prim = string;
interface P extends Prim {}
type Inter = { a: number } & { b: string };
interface OK extends Inter { c: boolean }
type Arr = number[];
interface OK2 extends Arr { extra: string }
type Fn = () => void;
interface OK3 extends Fn {}
type Tup = [number, string];
interface OK4 extends Tup {}
type Keyed<K extends string> = { [P in K]: number };
interface OK5 extends Keyed<'a' | 'b'> {}
interface Bad6<K extends string> extends Keyed<K> {}
type IU = { a: number } & ({ b: string } | { c: string });
interface Bad7 extends IU {}
interface AnyBase extends Record<string, any> {}
type Nv = never;
interface Bad8 extends Nv {}
type Ob = object;
interface Bad9 extends Ob {}
type Alias<T> = T;
interface H extends Alias<{ a: number }> {}
interface U extends Unknown {}
type S = { [k: string]: number };
interface I extends S {}
interface J extends Partial<{ a: number }> {}
interface K<T> extends Partial<T> {}
type Lit = 'a';
interface L extends Lit {}
type An = any;
interface M extends An {}
type Un = unknown;
interface N extends Un {}
interface O extends Array<number> {}
interface P extends Function {}
interface Q extends Object {}
type Cond<T> = T extends string ? { s: T } : { n: T };
interface R extends Cond<'x'> {}
interface V<T> extends Cond<T> {}
